definitions.ask: Should the Argon slugs carry an info model advisory saying they need Google AI Ultra?

choices.label: Picker, completion, and run labels show ⓘ needs Google AI Ultra; doctor warns on routes to Argon
No marker on any surface; the AI Ultra gate is documented only in docs/llms.md

definitions.why: Argon fails outright for most plans, and these surfaces are where users pick it

definitions.ask: Should Gemini 4 Argon join a shipped size alias?

choices.label: Reachable by name, picker, and completion only; no size alias routes to it automatically
Adds agy/gemini-4-argon-high to @large; non-Ultra agy users get some failed @large launches

definitions.why: agy exits 1 on models the account can't use, and aliases auto-route whenever agy is on PATH
